title: Restriction weights on selected coordinates
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\\delta$ be real, let $J\\subseteq\\{1,\\ldots,n\\}$, and let $g$ be a real-valued function on assignments of coordinate restrictions to $J$. Sum over all assignments of restrictions to the $n$ coordinates, weighting each by the product of its coordinate weights and evaluating $g$ on the restriction to $J$. This sum equals the sum over assignments on $J$ alone of the product of their coordinate weights times $g$ of that assignment.
hypotheses_covered: Real-valued function on restriction assignments to $J$
